text:
emily: Heads-up: planning a targeted canary for the base image rebuild tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Goals: validate cosign/KMS verification flow, confirm new RBAC bindings for signer SA, and ensure audit events include key id and signature envelope. Anyone free for watch?

adrian: I can join the watch window. How many nodes in the canary cluster?

emily: Starting with 2 nodes (canary-1) then expand to canary-3 if green. Expect ~20m push + 40m verification.

tara: FYI: I updated the RBAC proposal to only grant signer SA decrypt/get on the KMS key ring and denied list/roles. Posting YAML in a sec. Compliance asked we record the principal in the event payload.

secops-bot: Alert created: image-rebuild-canary-4456. Runbook: /runbooks/image-rebuild-keystore. Assigned: ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: I'll validate auditpipe and the Elastic ingest rule before the push. Last time we lost verification metadata when a log-forwarder filter dropped stderr.

rahul: Note about multi-region KMS: cosign verify may need KMS key alias mapping when verifying artifacts produced in other regions. Will provide env var mapping for the CI job.

nora: Do we have a fallback plan if cosign verify can't reach KMS due to transient network errors? We don't want automatic promotion of unsigned images.

emily: Rollout is gated. The pipeline will mark canary failed on verification error and trigger rollback. ops-oncall will manually approve retries.

adrian: Small operational note: the new keystore-role uses tight IAM bindings; buildkite agents might need short-lived tokens to access the key. Tara, can you coordinate token duration?

tara: Yes. I'll update the PR to set token TTL to 30m for the signer job and ensure tokens are minted via K8s tokenrequest API only for the signer SA.

rahul: For post-canary observability, let's emit a structured event with fields: image_digest, cosign_signature_hash, kms_key_id, build_id, git_sha. Ops can then correlate with traces.

ops-oncall: I'll create an adhoc job that runs after the verify step to push that structured event to the security index. If ingestion still drops fields, we'll fallback to copying cosign json output to the audit log.

nora: One more: make sure the audit retention policy includes these events for 180 days per compliance. I'll file a retention ticket if not.

emily: Thanks. Plan: tara opens the RBAC PR today, rahul supplies KMS alias mapping, ops-oncall does preflight 1h before, secops-bot will track incident. After canary, quick 15m retro to confirm logs & signoffs then scale.

adrian: Sounds good. Ping me if you need me to hammer on verification failures during the window.

tara: PR link: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-4523 (will add role YAML and token TTL snippet).

emily: Great — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
